newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suez Canal delegation to Qatar for gas talks.
newsitem.headline: Suez Canal delegation to Qatar for gas talks.

text.p: A delegation from the Suez Canal Authority (SCA), worried about declining revenues, left Cairo for Doha on Wednesday to hold talks on Qatari gas passing through the canal, officials said.

The SCA had feared Doha's earlier talks with Israel might lead to agreement on a pipeline between Eilat on the Gulf of Aqaba to Ashkelon on the Mediterranean coast to carry Qatari gas through to Europe.
In 1994, the SCA offered Qatar a 35 percent discount on LNG shipments in order to undermine any pipeline plans.
Qatar, a major natural gas producer, would like to start exports soon to Europe and the East Mediterranean.
Last year Qatar promised that any gas exports to Europe would pass through the canal, not by pipeline across Israel.

The director of planning, research and economic studies at SCA, Farouk Abu Talib, who heads the delegation, said Qatari officials had confirmed that they had ruled out the proposed Qatari-Israeli pipeline.
